title: Cui Bono?
html_source: Latin. “Who benefits, or stands to gain? To whose good is it…” (used legally, e.g., of a crime committed).

anchor.prefix: of Arran Quay, Inns Quay, Rotunda, Mountjoy and North Dock, better run a tramline, I say, from the cattlemarket to the river. That's the music of the future. That's my programme.
